$comment: §5.1 applies to every project type. The application form requirements hold every field on the Ontario 'Application for a Permit to Construct or Demolish' that the applicant fills in (Sections A to I; the City fills in the 'For use by Principal Authority' box, and Schedule 2 is only for sewage systems).

questions.text: Is the property owner someone other than the applicant?
questions.help: For example, a contractor applying for the owner. If so, the owner's details go in Section D of the application form.

questions.text: Do you know who will build or install the work?
questions.help: For example, a contractor. If you do, their details go in Section E (Builder) of the application form.

questions.text: Is the property a designated heritage property, or does the building have more than one unit?
